title: The Complete Tianji Record Manifests
next_chapter_hook: "When Chen Ji's palm presses against the Tianji Record, golden light swallows him whole—the final chapter of the ten-thousand-year chess game is about to begin."

text.content:
"When Chen Ji asks that question, the smile on the Demonic Path commander freezes, ten thousand years of silence condensed into a sigh, the gears of fate turn once more—unveiling ten thousand years of forbidden memories.

In the Void, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickers with a faint aura, releasing an ancient sigh: 'It has been far too long.' Scattered fragments of the Tianji Record seem to sense something, beginning to drift slowly toward Chen Ji, golden lights dancing in the air, weaving a delicate net of light."

"Ling Yuan's figure emerges in the distance, an expression of complex emotions flickering across his aged face as he murmurs: 'The day of unification has finally arrived.' His tone carries warning, yet also an inexplicable anticipation. Chen Ji senses an ancient召唤, as if something dormant for ten thousand years is awakening."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng drifts to Chen Ji's side, his remnant soul form flickering with complex light in his eyes: 'Twin children of destiny, one body with two faces. What you hold in your hand is the ember left by Chen Xuan, but the true Tianji Record... requires the other half to ignite.'"

text.content: "The first page of the Tianji Record begins folding inward, followed by the second, third, fourth—golden pages spinning, converging, merging in the Void. Golden motes pour down like a meteor shower, an ancient and solemn atmosphere permeating the air, as if heaven and earth are both witnessing this moment."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice trembles slightly: 'The twin children of destiny have finally reunited. Ten thousand years... the Tianji Record has finally awaited its complete moment.' Chen Ji feels a vast torrent of information flood his mind—the impact of the Tianji Record fragments merging with sealed knowledge, his vision swimming with dizziness."

text.content: "Five golden pages arrange themselves before Chen Ji into a complete scroll form, emanating a gentle yet majestic radiance. Chen Ji gazes at the complete Tianji Record in his hands, curiosity and anticipation surging in his heart—why does it manifest now? What does the fifth page conceal? Why must unification require such an agonizing wait?"

dialogue.content: "'Look at the final page.' Mo Xiansheng points to the fifth page of the scroll, his voice low and solemn, 'The power of the Tianji Record extends far beyond simply predicting the future.' Chen Ji turns to the last page as instructed—his pupils contract sharply—dense text emerges on the page, ancient and imposing energy rushing toward him."

text.content: "Chen Ji stares at the four characters 'Reshape Destiny,' his heart掀起惊涛骇浪. The fifth page's ability far exceeds prediction—it can rewrite established fate trajectories! But the cost is equally terrifying: burning everything of the user. He presses Mo Xiansheng for clarification, and after a moment of silence, the other speaks, his voice carrying a trace of compassion."

dialogue.content: "'Including life, soul, and... all bonds.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembles slightly, 'Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan saw the truth on this page, which is why he chose to shatter the Tianji Record. He didn't want anyone bearing such a cost.' Chen Ji grips the scroll tightly, his knuckles white."

choice.prompt: "The complete Tianji Record manifests, and Chen Ji finally learns the entire truth—his fate was destined from the start to be the fuel for the Tianji Record."

choices.description: "Since being a chess piece is inevitable, then proactively ignite the final chapter of this ten-thousand-year chess game. Trade his own burning for the power to rewrite everything."

dialogue.content: "A resolute light flashes in Chen Ji's eyes: 'Since fate demands I burn, then I shall burn away this ten-thousand-year darkness.' He presses his palm against the Tianji Record, golden light instantly engulfing his entire body."

choices.description: "The Tianji Record grants the ability to foresee destiny—why must rewriting destiny require burning? Chen Ji refuses to accept this obvious trap, determined to find a third path."
choices.visible_reward: "Perhaps a solution without burning can be found"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji's brow furrows tightly as he speaks in a low voice: 'Wait. The prophecy says the fifth page's ability is to burn everything—but who made that rule?' He examines the text on the Tianji Record once more, searching for possible loopholes."

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng gazes at him, a flicker of approval in his eyes: 'Chen Xuan searched too, ten thousand years ago, and found nothing. But perhaps... you can go further.'"

"The Tianji Record turns, revealing more detailed records—the Eye of Heavenly Dao sowed the seed of the Tianji Record ten thousand years ago, intending to use it as a chess piece. Chen Xuan was its chosen messenger, but after uncovering the truth, he betrayed it, causing the Tianji Record to shatter and wait for the next awakened one. Chen Ji's fate was sealed from the beginning."

"Chen Ji lets out a low laugh, its tone carrying traces of mockery: 'So I'm merely a piece in fate's chess game.' Yet the light in his eyes grows increasingly determined—he is no chess piece; he intends to become the player who controls the board. He continues flipping through the Tianji Record, seeking more truth."

dialogue.content: "'Wait.' Chen Ji suddenly speaks, pointing to a corner of a certain page, 'It says 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' here—what is this?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul pauses slightly, his gaze growing complicated."

"'Heavenly Fate Lock Key...' Mo Xiansheng falls silent for a long while before finally speaking, 'It is an existence that can break the limitations of the Tianji Record. Ten thousand years ago, the Eye of Heavenly Dao shattered the Tianji Record precisely because it discovered this variable.' His gaze falls upon Chen Ji, 'And that variable... is right by your side.'"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji suddenly thinks of one person—his sister Chen Nian, the sister taken away by the Holy Sect. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key... is it her?"

choices.description: "If the sister is the key, she must be found first. Perhaps her existence can change the ending of burning."
choices.risk_hint: "The timing for unification may be missed"

text.content: "Chen Ji grips the Tianji Record tightly, his heart already bearing an answer: 'Niannian... so you were the true key to this chess game.' He lifts his gaze toward the distant horizon, new hope kindling in his eyes."

choices.description: "Mo Xiansheng knows more truth and must be questioned first. Chen Nian's location, the specific function of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—all needs clarification."

dialogue.content: "'Where is Niannian? How is she now?' Chen Ji's voice carries suppressed urgency, 'You knew of her existence from the very beginning, didn't you?' Mo Xiansheng offers no answer, simply gazing at him quietly."

text.content: "The Tianji Record continues to turn, revealing more hidden records. The complete conditions for unification are finally unveiled—requiring the soul resonance of two Heavenly Fate individuals, the accumulation of a ten-thousand-year cycle, and more importantly... a soul willing to burn as fuel. This is the deadly trap set by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, its ultimate means of controlling destiny."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifts before Chen Ji, his voice low and solemn: 'After unification, you will possess the power to rewrite destiny. But the cost is burning everything you are—including your memories of her.' He glances at the Tianji Record, 'This is the scheme of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the ending Chen Xuan would rather die than allow.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji falls silent for a long while. Burning everything means losing it all—memories of Chen Nian, bonds with Su Qingyao, all the convictions gathered along this journey. But if he doesn't, the ten-thousand-year chess game will continue its cycle, and the next awakened one will face the same choice. He refuses to let anyone else bear such a weight."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji finally comprehends the entire truth. The Eye of Heavenly Dao set a deadly trap, demanding he burn everything to rewrite destiny. But the existence of his sister Chen Nian may be the key to breaking this trap."

choices.description: "The sister has already endured too much—Chen Ji refuses to involve her in this chess game. He chooses to bear the cost of burning alone, allowing his sister to live peacefully."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose everything, including memories of the sister"
choices.risk_hint: "The sister will lose her brother forever"

text.content: "Chen Ji takes a deep breath, reaching a decision: 'If someone must burn, let it be me. At least... Niannian won't have to wait anymore.' He extends his hand, palm pressing against the Tianji Record, golden light beginning to gather at his fingertips."

choices.description: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao says burning is mandatory, but Chen Ji refuses to believe there's no other way. Destiny is the chessboard—he intends to be the one who flips it."
choices.visible_cost: "May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao"
choices.visible_reward: "May find the true method to break the situation"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao's power is immeasurable"

text.content: "A cold light flashes in Chen Ji's eyes: 'For ten thousand years, the Eye of Heavenly Dao has treated me as a chess piece. But it forgot one thing—a chess piece can also flip the board.' He examines the Tianji Record once more, searching for overlooked details."

"Just then, the Tianji Record suddenly vibrates violently, the text on the fifth page beginning to change. A new line of text emerges—'The Heavenly Fate Lock Key can share the cost of burning, not limited to one person.' Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply: if Chen Nian is willing, they could bear this cost together... but this also means subjecting his sister to the same suffering."

"Mo Xiansheng gazes at the newly revealed text, releasing a long sigh: 'Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan saw this line, but he never found the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. You... are luckier than him, yet also more cruel.' Chen Ji clenches his fist, his heart churning with indescribable emotions—a new path, yet also one that demands his sister endure identical pain."

"Golden light burns in Chen Ji's pupils, the text on the fifth page seeming to come alive, whispering to him a truth spanning ten thousand years. The gears of destiny have already begun turning, and he must make the final choice. Burn, or seek the third path? Bear it alone, or face it together with his sister? The Tianji Record's radiance intensifies, awaiting his decision."

"The Tianji Record emits a gentle glow in his hands, as if responding to his decision. Mo Xiansheng drifts to the side, his remnant soul form waiting quietly—the ten-thousand-year chess game has finally reached its final stage. And the player is about to make the last move."
